fragment:
<cache-lookup-value key="@("obo-v2-" + context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("pv-user-token", "").GetHashCode().ToString())"
                        variable-name="pv-graph-token" />
    
        
            
                @($"https://login.microsoftonline.com/{{graph-tenant-id}}/oauth2/v2.0/token")
                POST
                
                    application/x-www-form-urlencoded
                
                @{
                    var userToken = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("pv-user-token", "");
                    var form = new System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary {
                        { "grant_type",           "urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer" },
                        { "client_id",            "{{graph-client-id}}" },
                        { "client_secret",        "{{graph-client-secret}}" },
                        { "assertion",            userToken },
                        { "scope",                "https://{{purview-graph-host}}/Content.Process.User https://{{purview-graph-host}}/ProtectionScopes.Compute.User https://{{purview-graph-host}}/ContentActivity.Write" },
                        { "requested_token_use",  "on_behalf_of" }
                    };
                    return string.Join("&", form.Select(kv => System.Uri.EscapeDataString(kv.Key) + "=" + System.Uri.EscapeDataString(kv.Value)));
                }
            
            <set-variable name="pv-graph-token"
                          value="@(((Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JObject)((IResponse)context.Variables["oboResponse"]).Body.As())["access_token"].ToString())" />
            <cache-store-value key="@("obo-v2-" + context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("pv-user-token", "").GetHashCode().ToString())"
                               value="@((string)context.Variables["pv-graph-token"])"
                               duration="3300" />
        
    

    
    
        @($"https://{{purview-graph-host}}/beta/me/dataSecurityAndGovernance/processContent")
        POST
        
            @("Bearer " + (string)context.Variables["pv-graph-token"])
        
        
            application/json
        
        @{
            var activity        = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("pv-activity", "uploadText");
            var text            = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("pv-text", "");
            var correlationId   = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("pv-correlation-id", System.Guid.NewGuid().ToString());
            var sequenceNumber  = (activity == "downloadText") ? 1 : 0;
            var nowIso          = DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss");
            var body = new Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JObject {
                ["contentToProcess"] = new Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JObject {
                    ["contentEntries"] = new Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JArray {
                        new Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JObject {
                            ["@odata.type"]      = "#microsoft.graph.processConversationMetadata",
                            ["identifier"]       = correlationId,
                            ["content"]          = new Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JObject {
                                ["@odata.type"] = "#microsoft.graph.textContent",
                                ["data"]        = text
                            },
                            ["name"]             = "APIM AI Gateway message",
                            ["correlationId"]    = correlationId,
                            ["sequenceNumber"]   = sequenceNumber,
                            ["isTruncated"]      = false,
                            ["createdDateTime"]  = nowIso,
                            ["modifiedDateTime"] = nowIso
                        }
                    },
                    ["activityMetadata"] = new Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JObject {
                        ["activity"] = activity
                    },
                    ["protectedAppMetadata"] = new Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JObject {
                        ["name"]    = "APIM AI Gateway",
                        ["version"] = "1.0",
                        ["applicationLocation"] = new Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JObject {
                            ["@odata.type"] = "#microsoft.graph.policyLocationApplication",
                            ["value"]       = "{{graph-client-id}}"
                        }
                    },
                    ["integratedAppMetadata"] = new Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JObject {
                        ["name"]    = "APIM AI Gateway",
                        ["version"] = "1.0"
                    }
                }
            };
            return body.ToString();
        }
    

    
    
    <set-variable name="pv-verdict" value="@{
        try {
            var pv = ((IResponse)context.Variables["pvResponse"]).Body.As(preserveContent: true);
            var actions = pv.SelectTokens("$.policyActions[*].action").Select(t => t.ToString()).ToList();
            return actions.Any(a => a.Equals("Block", System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || a.Equals("restrictAccess", System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || a.Equals("blockAccess", System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) ? "BLOCKED" : "ALLOWED";
        } catch { return "ALLOWED"; }
    }" />
    
    <set-variable name="pv-block-reason" value="@{
        var v = (string)context.Variables["pv-verdict"];
        var a = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("pv-activity", "uploadText");
        if (v != "BLOCKED") { return "none"; }
        return a == "uploadText" ? "PURVIEW_DLP_PROMPT" : "PURVIEW_DLP_RESPONSE";
    }" />
